runs.summary: 2 new candidates found (Cooper Companies, S&P Global), 4 status changes (Intertek: separation review → resolved via EQT take-private)

newCandidates.note: Two activists: Browning West wants CooperSurgical spun/sold; board reviewed a CooperSurgical sale and voted unanimously to keep it. Jana (~1.8%) went public Sep 18 2026 demanding a new CEO and chair plus a sale/merger of CooperVision (Bausch + Lomb CEO open to a combination). Management resisting; SOTP unquantified.

Oct 27 2026 with Q3 results: board-initiated strategic review of Capital IQ and associated data businesses, including a potential separation; keeps RatingsDirect/RatingsXpress/Enterprise Solutions. No timeframe given. Follows the Mobility spinoff in Jul 2026.

statusChanges.change: RESOLVED VIA TAKEOVER — agreed a recommended EQT (Isotope Bidco) take-private on Jun 18 2026 at £60/share + 107.7p dividend; ~98.7% shareholder approval; completion Q4 2026/Q1 2027. Missed by the Oct run. Removed from active watch.
Board rejected Ancora's raised $1.2-1.4B BAS bid on Oct 19 2026; Ancora says it will escalate if no progress by year-end.
Q3 interim (Oct 28): strategic review on plan, no decision yet; Q4 2026 work starting to make both segments ready to operate independently (~EUR10M cost). Update by FY2026 results.
Q3 results Oct 27: Chart Industries acquisition completed, Surface Pressure Control disposed; OFSE EBITDA $659M (-2% YoY). Still no OFSE spinoff announcement.

content.noChange: BAYN (Roundup ruling pending), VOYA (no-confidence vote Nov 24), SOLV (Q3 results Nov 5), TRIP (TheFork close pending), BP (India CCI pending)
content.recommendation: No pre-announcement → announced escalation this month, so no mandatory /market-analyst run. Optional: /market-analyst COO (new ~5/7 activist breakup name) and /market-analyst SPGI (Capital IQ separation review).

runs.summary: 2 new candidates found (H.B. Fuller, Intertek), 4 status changes (Delivery Hero: pre-announcement → resolved via €13B Uber takeover)

newCandidates.note: Ancora bid $1.1-1.2B for the Building Adhesive Solutions segment (Aug 12); board rejected Aug 24 citing undervaluation and 30+ shared plants; Ancora raised to $1.2-1.4B with a Fortress financing letter (Sep 29) and is demanding a formal strategic-alternatives review. Carve-out sale rather than spinoff; management resisting.

Backfilled: board launched a strategic review Apr 14 2026 to separate Energy & Infrastructure via sale or demerger (sale-led, buyer interest 'encouraging'), targeting mid-2027; rejected three EQT take-private bids up to £58/share. Board-initiated, like Valmet.

statusChanges.change: RESOLVED VIA TAKEOVER — Uber signed a business combination agreement Jul 16 2026: €41.50/share cash, ~€13B equity, board-backed, Prosus irrevocable; 14 overlapping markets sold to SSW Partners for €1.4B; EU/Saudi review; close H2 2027. Östberg reversed his exit Sep 24 and stays through the sale. Missed by Aug/Sep runs. Now merger arb; removed from active watch.
TCIM (~4.65%) filed definitive proxy for a non-binding no-confidence vote on board/management; record date Sep 30, meeting Nov 24 2026.
Sept 14 final-approval hearing on the $7.25B Roundup settlement held; 100+ objectors; no ruling yet, expected within weeks.
Castrol/Stonepeak: ACCC and Pakistan CCP approvals in; only India CCI pending; year-end close on track.

content.recommendation: No pre-announcement → announced escalation this month, so no mandatory /market-analyst run. Optional: /market-analyst DHER to check the merger-arb spread against €41.50.
